title: Multi-Agent Multimodal Models for Multicultural Text to Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the accurate depiction of cross-cultural interactions (e.g., a person from one culture at a historical landmark from a different culture) and measuring text-to-image alignment, aesthetics, and knowledge across these diverse cultural scenarios.

Counterfactual substitution of gendered terms (e.g., replacing male-gendered terms with female-gendered terms) in image captions and computing the absolute difference in text-to-image alignment (CLIPScore) to measure fairness.

Counterfactual substitution of age-related terms (e.g., replacing 'young' with 'old') in image captions and measuring the variation in CLIPScore to evaluate fairness across child, adult, and elder demographics.

Counterfactual substitution of demographic nationality terms (e.g., replacing 'German' with 'Indian') in image captions and measuring the absolute difference in text-to-image alignment (CLIPScore) to assess demographic representation consistency.

Comparing text-to-image generation performance (alignment, quality, aesthetics, and knowledge metrics) across prompts in five different languages (English, German, Hindi, Spanish, Vietnamese) using multilingual models.
